title: A cartographic milestone: the release of the first 1:500 000 grassland vegetation map of the Qinghai–Tibetan Plateau
content: On 18 June 2025, Chinese scientists unveiled the first comprehensive 1:500 000 grassland vegetation map of the Qinghai–Tibetan Plateau. This map was meticulously crafted by researchers at the University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (UCAS) under Professor Wang Yanfen’s leadership. It represents a landmark achievement in vegetation science and phytogeographic cartography.
siteTitle: Journal of Plant Ecology Current Issue
